## Handy chalk line
<p>The <strong>Handy chalk line</strong> is a practical and durable tool, ideal for making <strong>precise and quick markings</strong> on walls and work surfaces. The <strong>ABS body </strong>ensures high impact resistance, while the <strong>ergonomic Soft Grip handle</strong> provides a firm and comfortable grip during use. Equipped with a <strong>30 m line</strong>, it allows easy marking of long lines, while the<strong> 6x fast rewind system</strong> enables quick line retrieval, optimizing working time. The metal hook ensures stable anchoring at the start of marking, and the easy refill system makes it simple to refill the marking powder.</p>
<p data-start="2137" data-end="2532"><strong data-start="2137" data-end="2162">Instructions for use:</strong><br data-start="2162" data-end="2165" />Attach the hook to the starting point of the wall or surface to be marked and unwind the line, keeping it under tension up to the endpoint. With your free hand, pull the line slightly away from the surface, then release it so it snaps against the wall, allowing the chalk powder to leave a clearly visible line. At the end, rewind the line using the rotating crank.</p>
<h3 data-start="2534" data-end="2680">TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS</h3>
<ul>
<li data-start="2534" data-end="2680">impact resistant</li>
<li data-start="2534" data-end="2680">ergonomic Soft Grip handle</li>
<li data-start="2534" data-end="2680">6x fast rewind system</li>
<li data-start="2534" data-end="2680">metal hook</li>
<li data-start="2534" data-end="2680">easy refill system</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-start="2682" data-end="2716">MATERIALS</h3>
<ul>
<li data-start="2682" data-end="2716"><strong>Structure:</strong> ABS</li>
</ul>

## A2P3 mask filters
<p>The <strong>A2P3 filter</strong> is a combined filter with <strong>bayonet connection</strong>, designed to ensure effective protection <strong>against organic vapors, dust, fumes, and mists.</strong> Thanks to its advanced technology, this face mask filter meets various workplace safety needs, making it <strong>ideal for industrial, chemical, or painting environments.</strong></p>
<ul>
<li><strong>A2:</strong> protects against organic vapors with boiling point above 65°C, such as solvents, paints, and benzene.</li>
<li><strong>P3:</strong> protects against fine dust, fumes, and mists, including fine particles, welding fumes, and oily mists.</li>
</ul>
<p data-start="3313" data-end="3494">Thanks to its compact design and bayonet connection, the A2P3 filter is easy to mount on the Twin Fly protective mask (Item 32576) and ensures safe breathing without compromising user comfort.</p>
<h3>TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS</h3>
<ul>
<li>combined filter</li>
<li>bayonet connection</li>
<li>A2 filter</li>
<li>P3 filter</li>
</ul>

## Touch Plus work gloves
<p data-start="121" data-end="300"><strong>Touch Plus protective gloves </strong>ensure excellent grip and durability thanks to the sandy nitrile coating, designed to provide outstanding adhesion on dry, wet, or oily surfaces.</p>
<p data-start="302" data-end="579"><strong>The cellular structure of the glove coating</strong> helps <strong>disperse fluids, improving grip, </strong>while the high abrasion resistance ensures durability even in demanding conditions. The 15-gauge stretch nylon <strong>lining</strong>, <strong>flexible and breathable</strong>, offers a comfortable fit and excellent dexterity.</p>
<p data-start="581" data-end="761">Touch Plus protective gloves are ideal for material handling, logistics, construction sites, light assembly, <strong>automotive,</strong> as well as plumbing, heating, oil, and mining industries.</p>

## Micro Touch gloves

The elastic nylon provides the work gloves with a comfortable and precise fit, while the 21-gauge structure makes Micro Touch gloves thin and lightweight without compromising protection.</p>
<p data-start="1034" data-end="1301">Ideal for numerous applications, these precision work gloves are suitable for general material handling, warehouse and logistics, construction, assembly and light industry, automotive sector, plumbing and heating systems, as well as the oil and mining industries.</p>

## Cut Evo work gloves
<p data-path-to-node="3"><strong>Cut Evo work gloves </strong>offer a perfect combination of protection, comfort, and dexterity, designed for those working in heavy-duty conditions. The nitrile micro-foam coating ensures <strong>excellent grip</strong> while maintaining <strong>high flexibility and tactile sensitivity. </strong>The breathable palm reduces sweating, ensuring comfort even during extended shifts.</p>
<p data-path-to-node="4">The<strong> K-Mesh 3D lining </strong>of Cut Evo cut-resistant gloves is soft, lightweight, and well-ventilated, offering the highest European level of <strong>cut resistance (Test F)</strong>, ideal for handling sharp or jagged materials.</p>
<p data-path-to-node="5">Cut Evo work gloves are particularly suitable for applications such as handling sharp glass and metals, construction and warehousing, metalworking, the automotive industry, and recycling.</p>

## Vacuum suction cup
<p>The <strong>Vacuum Suction Pad </strong>for lifting tiles and heavy materials guarantees a <strong>horizontal load capacity of up to 120 kg.</strong> Made of durable aluminium with rubber coating and Progrip handle made of non-slip 2-component plastic, the Vacuum Tile Suction Pad guarantees high performance, safety and ease of use.&nbsp;</p>
<p>The <strong>suction cup's manual vacuum pump </strong>is activated by pressing. On the button, the safety indicator disappears once the suction pad reaches the ideal vacuum and the dial pointer moves to green. In the event of a loss of vacuum, the safety indicator reappears and the pointer moves to the red dial, at which point it is necessary to pump again to maintain the ideal vacuum charge in the suction cup.</p>
<p>The Vacuum Suction Cup is equipped with a <strong>manual decompression valve</strong> that allows the suction cup to be easily removed from the surface to be handled. The vacuum gauge also monitors the gripping state of the vacuum cup, indicating to the operator when the vacuum needs to be restored.</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS</h3>
<ul>
<li>shock-proof rubber-coated aluminium structure</li>
<li>diameter 200mm&nbsp;</li>
<li>horizontal capacity 120kg&nbsp;</li>
<li>ABS handle supports&nbsp;</li>
<li>natural rubber pad with high adhesive effect</li>
<li>ergonomic Progrip Bi-component handle&nbsp;</li>
<li>vacuum gauge to monitor grip status</li>
<li>protective cover to protect the pad&nbsp;</li>
<li>complete with plastic case</li>
</ul>

## KDM 1500 core drill
<p>The KDM 1500 manual dry core drill with its brushless technology, low weight of only 3.5 KG, micro-vibration and soft start is the safest, most powerful and lightest core drill on the market. The machine is equipped with 2 mechanical speeds, thermal and overload protection to ensure maximum efficiency for the operator and protect him from kickback. Thanks to a sensor that controls its speed, when the core drill reaches 550 RPM, the motor stops. The micro-percussion, with which the machine is equipped, keeps the drill bit lively and improves drilling efficiency. By fitting Kapriol diamond drills, the core drill is suitable for dry core drilling in reinforced concrete.</p>
<p>Use in conjunction with KDSR400 core drill stand (item 57014) is recommended.</p>
<h3>EQUIPMENT</h3>
<p>1. Secondary handle 2. SDS plus quick coupling 3. Service wrenches set<br />4. SDS centering bit</p>

## Chemical protective gloves
<p data-start="176" data-end="429">Chemical gloves are designed to ensure <strong>high safety in industrial and chemical environments,</strong> thanks to the full smooth nitrile coating with nitrile lining that provides an <strong>effective barrier against bacteria, fungi, </strong>and a wide range of chemical substances.</p>
<p data-start="431" data-end="639">These work gloves offer basic mechanical resistance combined with excellent long-lasting chemical protection, while maintaining good ergonomics, flexibility, and a stable grip even in the presence of liquids.</p>
<p data-start="641" data-end="1004">Chemical protection gloves are certified according to EN 374-1:2016/A1:2018 (Type A) and <strong>EN 374-5:2016 </strong>for <strong>protection against specific chemicals,</strong> bacteria, and fungi. They are ideal for chemical industry work, professional cleaning, maintenance, water treatment, professional agriculture, and food industry applications where there is no direct contact with food.</p>

## Skin Gloves
<p data-path-to-node="3"><strong>Skin and Skin White work gloves</strong> are designed to offer lightness, dexterity, and comfort in a wide range of professional and domestic applications. The<strong> smooth PU coating</strong> guarantees high tactile sensitivity and a reliable grip, ideal for operations requiring precision. The polyester <strong>lining</strong> is <strong>breathable </strong>and <strong>elastic</strong>, adapting perfectly to the hand, while the seamless design ensures maximum dexterity and comfort even during prolonged use.</p>
<p data-path-to-node="4">These <strong>precision work gloves</strong> also feature a knit wrist that prevents dirt and debris from entering, keeping the glove stable and hygienic. Both models comply with the EN 388:2016 + A1:2018 standard and offer a reliable level of mechanical protection.</p>
<p data-path-to-node="5">The <strong>black Skin </strong>work gloves are available in <strong>multipacks of 12 and 60 pieces</strong>, while the <strong>Skin White</strong> gloves are available in <strong>6-piece multipacks</strong>, ideal for frequent use or for those who prefer a practical stock format.&nbsp;</p>
<p data-path-to-node="6">Thanks to their versatility, Skin work gloves are ideal for electronics and the technology industry, assembly and light industry, general material handling, warehousing and logistics, the automotive industry, and agriculture and gardening. The Skin White model, more oriented towards daily use, is perfect for household chores and tasks such as drywalling or small home repairs.</p>

## ZENITH 3D TS-HH-LGS-SIL
<p>Zenith 3D is the new disc that is made from 3D Evolution technology, has exceeded&nbsp;limits set by old technologies. The diamond grains can now be set in various&nbsp;configurations, equidistant and are perfectly aligned on each layer of the diamondsector within the binder.<br />Thanks to this new technology, when a diamond layer wears down a new layer with the&nbsp;same aligned grain quantity is equally exposed out of the binder.&nbsp;Equal consumption of Zenith 3D allows the machines upon which the diamond tools are mounted to keep the number of motor revolutions constant and never operates&nbsp;under charge. The tool is constantly sharpened, maintaining maximum stability and&nbsp;eliminates almost all load and vibration excess from the operator, especially in manual&nbsp;applications.<br />Urban noise pollution (excessive exposure to sounds and noises of&nbsp;high intensity) over time can cause serious problems of various kinds&nbsp;<br />(psychological, stress, hearing and various illnesses).<br />For this reason, it is regulated by specific legislation.&nbsp;As such, we strongly recommend the use of diamond discs that feature&nbsp;Zenith 3D technology and a silent core that drastically reduce noise by&nbsp;absorbing vibration.</p>

<li>&nbsp;Brick 🟠🟠🟠</li>

## Zenit 3D cutting disc GM-BB
<p><strong>Zenith 3D GM-BB </strong>is the <strong>new diamond disc</strong> that uses <strong>3D Evolution technology</strong> with diamond grains arranged in various configurations, equidistant from each other and perfectly aligned on each layer of the diamond sector within the bond. This innovation ensures that, as one layer of the diamond disc wears down, a new layer of aligned grains is uniformly exposed, guaranteeing high performance.</p>
<p>The <strong>uniform wear of Zenith 3D</strong> allows the machines on which it is mounted to maintain a <strong>constant engine speed and never work under load, maintaining maximum stability and almost totally eliminating overload</strong> and vibration to the operator.</p>
<p>The platinum quality diamond grooving disc is <strong>suitable for dry cutting of bricks and concrete.</strong></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>MATERIAL TYPE</h3>
<ul>
<li>Brick 🟠🟠🟠</li>
<li>Cement 🟠🟠🟠</li>
</ul>
<h3>QUALITY STANDARDS</h3>
<ul>
<li>Platinum quality</li>
</ul>
<h3>CUTTING INSTRUCTIONS</h3>
<ul>
<li>Dry cutting</li>
<li>Wet cutting</li>
</ul>

## Metal Max cutting disc
<p><strong>Metal Max grinding disc with Vacuum technology</strong> that gives the disc long life and maximum efficiency, <strong>reducing metal cutting costs.&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>The Metal Max cutting disc is a new and viable <strong>alternative to abrasive discs</strong>, offering the following advantages: <strong>constant cutting height, elimination of risk of breakage, high reduction of odour and dust residue.</strong></p>
<p>This multi-purpose disc is suitable for dry or wet cutting of different types of materials such as: <strong>sheet metal, aluminium, stainless steel, iron and cast iron.&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>MATERIAL TYPE</h3>

## Zenith 3D Sonic Evolution disc Silent diamond disc
<p><strong>Zenith 3D Sonic Evolution 3D </strong>is the new cutting disc that makes use of <strong>3D Evolution technology </strong>based on a special geometric arrangement of diamond grains in configurations that are equidistant from each other and perfectly aligned on each layer of the diamond sector within the bond.&nbsp;</p>
<p>The new technology of this grinder disc<strong> guarantees a 30 to 70 per cent improvement </strong>in diamond tool life and performance. Thanks to this new technology, when a diamond layer wears off, a new layer with the same amount of aligned grains is evenly exposed outside the binder. The uniform wear of Zenith 3D allows the machines on which it is mounted to maintain a constant engine speed and never work under load. &nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Silent technology</strong>, on the other hand, by inserting a layer of sound-absorbing material between two steel cores of the diamond blade, <strong>allows vibrations to be absorbed and high-frequency noise to be reduced </strong>during cutting.&nbsp;</p>
<p>The Zenith 3D Sonic Evolution diamond blade is <strong>suitable for cutting resistant materials</strong> such as <strong>concrete, reinforced concrete, bricks, stone and granite.&nbsp;</strong></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>

## Disque à découper Zenith 3D F-LCB
<p><strong>Zenith 3D F-LCB est le nouveau disque à découper</strong> utilisant la <strong>technologie 3D Evolution</strong>, qui permet de disposer les grains de diamant dans différentes configurations, à équidistance les uns des autres et parfaitement alignés sur chaque couche du secteur diamanté à l'intérieur du liant. Cette nouvelle technologie garantit que lorsqu'une couche de diamant s'use, une nouvelle couche de la même quantité est exposée uniformément à l'extérieur du liant.</p>
<p>Le disque à découper Zenith 3D F-LCB est<strong> certifié par l'OSA</strong> conformément à la norme EN 13236 et <strong>convient au béton, à la brique, à la pierre et au granit,</strong> garantissant une longue durée de vie.&nbsp;</p>
<p>L'usure régulière des disques diamantés Zenith 3D permet de maintenir la vitesse du moteur constante et de ne jamais travailler en charge, en maintenant une stabilité maximale et en éliminant presque totalement les surcharges et les vibrations pour l'opérateur.&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>TYPE DE MATÉRIAU</h3>
<ul>
<li>Brique 🟠🟠🟠</li>
<li>Ciment 🟠🟠🟠</li>
<li>Béton armé 🟠🟠🟠</li>
<li>Abrasifs/Réfractaires 🟠🟠</li>
<li>Granit/pierre 🟠🟠</li>
</ul>

</ul>

</ul>

## Zenith 3D F-TG cutting disc
<p>The <strong>Zenith 3D F-TG diamond grinding disc</strong> in platinum quality is suitable for cutting brick, concrete, reinforced concrete, abrasive/refractory materials, granite and stone. The high <strong>speed technology </strong>offers high speed and a clean cut even on tough materials.&nbsp;</p>
<p>This diamond blade is manufactured using <strong>modern Zenith 3D technology </strong>based on the geometric arrangement of diamond grains, which can <strong>increase the lifetime and performance of the diamond blade by 30 to 70%.</strong></p>
<p>Suitable for both dry and wet cutting, the Zenith 3D F-TG diamond blade guarantees a long service life, making it a reliable tool for professionals.&nbsp;</p>

## ZENITH DM-LWET h.450 mm
<p>Zenith 3D is the new disc that is made from 3D Evolution&nbsp;technology, has exceeded limits set by old technologies.&nbsp;The diamond grains can now be set in various configurations,&nbsp;equidistant and are perfectly aligned on each layer of&nbsp;the diamond sector within the binder. Thanks to this new&nbsp;technology, when a diamond layer wears down a new layer&nbsp;with the same aligned grain quantity is equally exposed out&nbsp;of the binder.</p>
<p>Net height 450 mm</p>
<p><strong>Advantages of Zenith 3D technology in drilling system:</strong><br />• Drilling speed and duration increased from 30 to 70%<br />• Powder deflux facilitated by the spiral shape of the drum&nbsp;for better cooling<br />• Quick centring, fast drilling speed and less friction&nbsp;guaranteed by the special pointed design of the segment.<br />• Reduced vibration<br />• Less machine overload due to special arrangement of&nbsp;diamond layers<br />• Less maintenance and longer service life<br />• Less operator effort</p>
<h4>MATERIALS TYPE AND QUALITY STANDARD&nbsp;</h4>
<ul>
<li>Brick 🟠🟠🟠&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;&nbsp;</li>

<p>Zenith 3D is the new disc that is made from 3D Evolution&nbsp;technology, has exceeded limits set by old technologies.&nbsp;The diamond grains can now be set in various configurations,&nbsp;equidistant and are perfectly aligned on each layer of&nbsp;the diamond sector within the binder. Thanks to this new&nbsp;technology, when a diamond layer wears down a new layer&nbsp;with the same aligned grain quantity is equally exposed out&nbsp;of the binder.</p>

Thanks to this new&nbsp;technology, when a diamond layer wears down a new layer&nbsp;with the same aligned grain quantity is equally exposed out&nbsp;of the binder.</p>
<p>Net height 200 mm</p>
<p><strong>Advantages of Zenith 3D technology in drilling system:</strong><br />• Drilling speed and duration increased from 30 to 70%<br />• Reduced lateral friction and less risk of blocking the&nbsp;rotating drill bit thanks to conical structure.<br />• Powder deflux facilitated by the spiral shape of the drum&nbsp;for better cooling<br />• Quick centring, fast drilling speed and less friction&nbsp;guaranteed by the special pointed design of the segment.<br />• Weight reduced by 30-40% on the dry model thanks to&nbsp;the internal machining of the bottom<br />• Reduced vibration<br />• Less machine overload due to special arrangement of&nbsp;diamond layers<br />• Less maintenance and longer service life<br />• Less operator effort</p>

<p data-start="532" data-end="803">Certifications EN 388:2016 + A1:2018, EN 374-1:2016/A1:2018, and EN 374-5:2016 confirm a <strong>high level of mechanical protection, specific resistance to chemical substances, and a barrier against microorganisms,</strong> making these reliable and versatile chemical protection gloves.</p>
<p data-start="805" data-end="986">Super PVC work gloves are ideal for industrial maintenance, biological laboratories, biological waste handling, chemical industry, agriculture, gardening, and professional cleaning.</p>

## Neoprene gloves
<p data-start="170" data-end="330"><strong>Neoprene work gloves </strong>are protective gloves designed for users working in chemical and biological environments, thanks to the<strong> full neoprene and latex coating.</strong></p>
<p data-start="332" data-end="556">These chemical protection gloves provide a <strong>secure grip and waterproof protection,</strong> combining the <strong>resistance </strong>of neoprene <strong>against corrosive substances, solvents, and detergents</strong> with the comfort and tactile sensitivity of latex.</p>
<p data-start="558" data-end="782">Certified according to EN 374-1:2016/A1:2018 (Type B), EN 374-5:2016, and EN 421:2010, neoprene gloves <strong>ensure protection against specific chemicals, microorganisms, and radiation,</strong> while maintaining lightness and flexibility.</p>
<p data-start="784" data-end="984">Neoprene gloves are suitable for chemical and pharmaceutical industries, cosmetics industry, professional cleaning, waste management, handling of radioactive materials, and decontamination activities.</p>

## Blaster split suede leather gloves
<p data-start="223" data-end="619"><strong>Blaster split leather gloves</strong> are designed to ensure <strong>maximum safety in high-temperature applications,</strong> offering an excellent combination of mechanical and thermal protection without compromising dexterity and precision. Made from <strong>high-quality suede leather</strong>, these high-temperature gloves provide excellent resistance to abrasion, tearing, and heat, making them ideal for intensive professional use.</p>
<p data-start="621" data-end="981">Blaster gloves maintain good tactile sensitivity, essential for professions such as welding where precision and control are required.</p>
<p data-start="621" data-end="981"><strong> The 15 cm cuff length</strong> effectively protects the wrist and forearm from sparks, radiant heat, and molten metal splashes, while the 1–1.2 mm leather thickness ensures durability and long service life even in demanding conditions.</p>
<p data-start="983" data-end="1200">Blaster welding gloves are certified according to <strong>EN 388:2016 + A1:2018, EN 407:2020, and EN 12477:2001 + A1:2005 Type A</strong>, ensuring high performance in thermal and mechanical safety for professional welding operations.</p>
<h3 data-start="1202" data-end="1230">TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS</h3>
<ul data-start="1231" data-end="1547">

## Velvet Red gloves
<p data-start="175" data-end="542">Velvet Red split leather and cotton work gloves are designed to provide an optimal balance of protection, comfort, and mechanical resistance in medium to high-risk tasks. <strong>The suede split leather palm</strong> ensures excellent abrasion resistance and long durability, while the <strong>fabric back </strong>with split leather inserts provides flexibility and comfort even during prolonged use.</p>
<p data-start="544" data-end="841">Velvet Red split leather and cotton gloves also feature a<strong> lined palm</strong> that reduces hand fatigue, while<strong> reinforced split leather on the thumb and index</strong> finger protects the areas most subject to wear. Finally, <strong>the internal elastic cuff</strong> ensures a secure fit and prevents dirt and debris from entering.</p>
<p data-start="843" data-end="1028">These split leather and cotton work gloves <strong>comply with EN 388:2016 + A1:2018</strong> and are suitable for industrial and mechanical maintenance, agriculture, gardening, carpentry, and forestry.</p>

<p data-start="184" data-end="653"><strong>Driver Comby work gloves</strong> combine durability and comfort thanks to their hybrid construction with <strong>full-grain leather on the palm and split suede leather on the back.</strong> The full-grain leather palm ensures<strong> excellent abrasion resistance,</strong> providing protection and long-lasting performance even in the most demanding applications. The split suede back, on the other hand, offers <strong>breathability and flexibility,</strong> enhancing comfort during prolonged use without compromising safety.</p>
<p data-start="655" data-end="896">These leather work gloves feature a thickness of 1–1.2 mm, ensuring high resistance and durability. The combination of robust materials and ergonomic design makes Driver Comby gloves ideal for tasks requiring high protection and reliability.</p>
<p data-start="898" data-end="1083">Leather work gloves are suitable for <strong>heavy-duty work, </strong>agriculture, gardening, forestry, and carpentry. They offer an optimal balance between durability, protection, and working comfort.</p>

## Tiler Top Waterproof Gloves
<p data-path-to-node="3"><strong>Tiler Top work gloves</strong> guarantee maximum protection and a superior grip thanks to the <strong>differentiated latex coating</strong>. This combination of an embossed layer and a smooth layer creates a completely waterproof barrier that ensures <strong>exceptional grip on dry, wet, and oily surfaces,</strong> providing control and safety even in the most delicate operations.</p>
<p data-path-to-node="4">The 15G nylon <strong>lining </strong>— <strong>soft, breathable, and highly flexible</strong>—wraps around the hand, improving dexterity and reducing fatigue during prolonged use. The seamless construction and the natural softness of the latex further increase comfort, making Tiler Top work gloves pleasant to wear throughout the entire workday.</p>
<p data-path-to-node="5"><strong>Compliant with the EN 388:2016 + A1:2018 </strong>standard, these gloves offer excellent protection and a superior feeling of comfort. Thanks to their high performance, Tiler Top gloves are ideal for construction and maintenance, assembly, light industry, agriculture, gardening, and quality control, representing a solid and professional choice for those seeking top-level resistance and grip.</p>

<p data-start="705" data-end="1075">Thanks to their combination of lightness, dexterity, and durability, these nitrile work gloves are ideal for material handling, warehouse and logistics, construction, light industry, assembly, automotive sector, painting, household tasks, and plumbing or heating work. <strong>Compliant with EN 388:2016 + A1:2018,</strong> they guarantee reliability and practicality in every situation.</p>

This safety shoe is equipped with an<strong> EVA footbed</strong> which, thanks to the presence of gel inserts, provides a <strong>high level of comfort to the fit.</strong>&nbsp;<br />The upper of the derby work shoe is made of micro-perforated synthetic material to guarantee <strong>good breathability of the foot</strong>, making it an <strong>excellent summer safety shoe</strong> for both men and women.&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h3>TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS</h3>
<ul>
<li>EVA insole with gel inserts</li>
<li>upper with microperforated synthetic material inserts to guarantee breathability&nbsp;</li>
<li>suede leather reinforcements</li>
<li>tongue with lace pocket</li>
<li>non-slip treads guarantee excellent grip on all surfaces</li>
</ul>
<h3>MATERIAL</h3>
<ul>
<li>Outsole: polyurethane</li>
<li>Upper: split suede with synthetic material inserts</li>
<li>Toe cap: steel</li>
</ul>

<li>S3L</li>
<li>SR</li>
<li>FO</li>

## Chalk line Light kit 30m
<p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-pre-wrap leading-[1.7]">Chalk line with a <strong>sturdy </strong>compact <strong>body </strong>in <strong>polypropylene </strong>(PP) with an ergonomic <strong>anti-slip</strong> shape. The<strong> 30-metre</strong> line of this marking tool can be wound easily thanks to the <strong>practical 1x rewinding mechanism.</strong></p>
<p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-pre-wrap leading-[1.7]">The chalk line kit comes complete with a <strong>blue powder bottle </strong>of <strong>120 gr</strong>.</p>
<h3 class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">HOW TO USE</h3>
<p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Press the release button and pull out the line by gripping the metal fixing hook. Attach the hook to the start of the wall to be marked, unwind the line keeping it taut until the end of the marking. With your free hand, pull the line slightly away from the wall, then release it so it snaps against the surface, allowing the coloured powder to mark a line. Rewind the line using the rotary crank.</p>
